blocks.text: After logging in to Postman, you can import the Postman collection for OneAPI. To add the collection to the Postman application:

blocks.item: Download the latest Postman collection for OneAPI using this OneAPI Postman collection.
In the Postman application, go to your preferred workspace. The default workspace is My Workspace.
Click Import. Alternatively, you can go to the application menu on the top-left corner and click File > Import.

blocks.text: In the import window that appears, select your Postman collection file or drag the file to the import window. The Postman collection for OneAPI is imported into the application. A new folder with the name used within the Postman collection file (e.g., OneAPI) is displayed within Collections in the left-side navigation.
